name: @skills/skill-builder
description: Meta-skill for creating new reusable skills. Research, compile, and validate skills using structured templates.

exit_when: User just wants to use existing skills, not create new ones
Request is for modifying existing skill (use skill-updater instead)
proceed_when: User wants to create a new skill from scratch
Need to document a complex workflow as reusable skill
Converting manual procedure into skill format

author: l3enjamin
